title: Openhands — Free Bootstrap 6 Charity & NGO Website Template
excerpt: A free two-page Bootstrap 6 charity template — a donate widget that says what each amount buys, transparent fund allocation from real accounts, programmes, stories and a volunteer form.
yoastTitle: Openhands — Free Bootstrap 6 Charity & NGO Website Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 charity, NGO and nonprofit website template with a donation widget showing what each amount buys, Gift Aid switch, transparent fund allocation, appeal progress bar, volunteer form and a full appeal page.
intro: Openhands is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 website template for charities, NGOs, nonprofits, foundations and community organisations. It pairs a full charity homepage — donate widget, impact figures, fund allocation, programmes, a story and a volunteer enquiry — with an appeal page carrying target progress and a sticky donate rail.
note: The donate widget is the whole template. Choosing an amount immediately says what that amount buys — because "£50" means nothing on its own, while "£50 pays for a week of hot meals" is the entire fundraising argument, and it belongs where the decision is being made rather than in a footnote. The tiers carry their own copy in data-buys, so adding one is an HTML edit with no script change. A custom amount deliberately stops claiming a specific outcome rather than inventing one. The fund-allocation section publishes real percentages including fundraising cost, because "the majority goes to the cause" is not a number.
summary: Openhands is a free, premium two-page Bootstrap 6 template for charities and NGOs. The homepage pairs a photographic hero with a donate widget where the amount selection updates a live statement of what that gift buys, plus frequency radios, a custom amount field and a Gift Aid switch. Below: impact figures, a transparent fund-allocation breakdown built from progress bars including fundraising cost, three programme cards, a beneficiary story and a volunteer enquiry form using multi-select Combobox and Datepicker. The appeal page adds target progress, a cost breakdown and a sticky donate rail listing every tier. Warm, plain design with no gradients. ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step, full light and dark mode.
features: Two pages — charity homepage and an appeal page
Donate widget where choosing an amount says what that amount buys
Tier copy lives in data-buys, so adding a tier needs no script change
Custom amounts stop claiming a specific outcome rather than inventing one
Amount choice is a radio group, so it is one form value with real keyboard semantics
Gift Aid switch and once/monthly frequency toggle
Transparent fund allocation including fundraising cost, not just the flattering number
Appeal page with target progress bar and a sticky donate rail
Volunteer enquiry with multi-select Combobox and Datepicker
Bootstrap 6 vendored at a pinned commit, ESM-only, no build step
